content.text:
**Packaging update:** the latest deployed main was `1428e15`; it did not include the onboarding fix. The fix was already integrated and tested on top of that commit, preserving its changes.

I prepared a 122 MiB source archive, then a 111 MiB filtered package using Railway’s documented `.railwayignore` mechanism. Both upload attempts failed at `SNAPSHOT_CODE` with: “Failed to create code snapshot. Please review your last commit, or try again.” The first CLI attempt also timed out; the second deployment record, `0c7fdb63-8086-4880-978e-ff1abe9f0572`, is confirmed failed. Railway has no pending deployment. Production remains online on `81f7f453-6a73-435b-acd4-aef0de2ebad1`; no fix deployment succeeded, so live browser verification was not possible.

The existing local evidence for the candidate is 3/3 targeted Playwright regressions passing, 12/12 draft utility tests passing, both client and server builds passing, and `tsc --noEmit` passing. These do **not** establish production behavior.

The candidate’s four scoped source/test files are `e2e/brief-signin.e2e.ts`, `src/components/brief/use-brief-strength.ts`, `src/components/onboarding/anti-tabula-rasa.tsx`, and `src/components/onboarding/writing-format-input.tsx`. The `.railwayignore` used for the retry exists only in the temporary deployment copy. No unrelated checkout changes were edited.

**Remaining blocker:** Railway’s source snapshot service rejected both reduced packages before build logs were produced. Deployment and live verification need a working supported Railway snapshot/upload path. [Railway CLI upload documentation](https://docs.railway.com/cli/up) confirms `.railwayignore` support.

That explains the mismatch: the onboarding fix passed locally but never reached production. The snapshot failures are from the earlier upload attempts; deployments through GitHub `main` have since succeeded. I’ll validate those four candidate files against current production code and ship them through that working path.
